The '''House Ministry of Inquiry''', also known as '''MI''', was a [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-old [[spynet]] under the control of [[House Mecetti]]. MI had infiltrated most of the other [[Tapani Noble Houses|Noble Houses]] by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], as well as [[Agent/Legends|agents]] within the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]].<ref name="LE" />
